speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing sudden-onset lower back pain that radiates down your leg; to begin my assessment, have you experienced any weakness, numbness, or tingling in that leg, and does the pain worsen when you cough or sneeze?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Disc Herniation (likely L5-S1)
Based on your age, the sudden onset during exercise, and the radiation of pain to the foot, this clinical picture is classic for a slipped disc. I will now order an MRI of your lumbar spine to confirm the diagnosis and assess the extent of nerve compression. REQUEST IMAGES: Lumbar_Spine_MRI
